title: how to get databricks job id at the run time
question:
I am trying to get the job id and run id of a databricks job dynamically and keep it on in the table with below code

run_id = self.spark.conf.get("spark.databricks.job.runId", "no_run_id")
job_id = self.spark.conf.get("spark.databricks.job.id", "unknown_job_id")
logger.debug(f"run_id {run_id}, job_id {job_id}")

It does not return run_id and job_id. I am not running my code on notebook. I am writing code in vscode then github.
